headline.purpose: Bold compact headings establish each section.

body.purpose: Readable interface copy explains disconnected and unavailable states.

shadows.name: card-low
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift below bordered white cards.

breakpoints.name: navigation-rail
breakpoints.purpose: Uses a labeled NavigationRail on wider layouts; phones use a bottom NavigationBar.

components.name: Content Surface
components.description: Material card with pale border, low elevation, and 16dp inset.
components.html:
Power, when it’s measured

Waiting for a live reading
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #e1e8ee; border-radius: 22px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #1c476114; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { color: #61738b; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four native Material destinations with a soft emerald selection indicator; wide screens use a labeled NavigationRail.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav"><button>Power Now</button><button class="ds-selected" aria-current="page">Stop Waste</button><button>Sleep Check</button><button>Ask & Add</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 80px; justify-content: space-around; padding: 8px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font: 600 11px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-nav .ds-selected { border-radius: 999px; background: #e3f5ed; color: #008f68; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Round Icon Well
components.description: 42dp circular tinted icon background for section and setup cues.
components.css: .ds-icon { display: inline-grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #e3f5ed; color: #008f68; font: 24px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Metric Placeholder
components.description: Inset metric tile with an explicit unavailable label and supporting explanation.
components.html:
Useful power

Activity and device context will explain what is doing useful work.
components.css: .ds-metric { padding: 15px; border-radius: 16px; background: #f8fafc; color: #0f172a; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-metric p { margin: 9px 0 0; color: #61738b; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Setup Disclosure
components.description: Native expansion affordance listing prerequisites for connecting a monitored device.
components.html:
What you’ll need

A compatible plug, local hub, and the upcoming connection flow.
components.css: .ds-details { padding: 8px 0; color: #0f172a; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-details summary { color: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-details p { color: #61738b; } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The mobile implementation follows the local Figma export /Users/nik/Downloads/energylens.pdf: page 9 (Stop Waste), page 10 (Sleep Check), and page 12 (Power Now). Ask & Add follows /Users/nik/Downloads/stitch_intelligent_energy_waste_monitor/ask_anything_easy_add_light/screen.png. The PDF mobile screens are primary layout authority; web desktop adapts their hierarchy and styling. Flutter retains EnergyLens branding and native Material navigation and text scaling. The current interface has disconnected and unavailable states, with no readings, verified savings, assistant responses, or device controls.
dos: Do distinguish unavailable, estimated, and measured values.
Do keep hub-disconnected status neutral and visible.
Do follow the documented Figma pages and Ask & Add screen.
donts: Don’t copy illustrative readings, names, savings, or household claims from the references.
Don’t imply active readings, verified outcomes, assistant responses, or device controls.
